harper: quick heads-up 1 - running a small rehearsal for the keystone entitlement prune in staging tomorrow 07:30 PT. goal: validate owner attribution, exercise KMS grant revoke/reattach, and confirm audit-proxy replay.
dmitri: please list canary services and abort criteria.
harper: canary: keystone-api, billing-ingest. abort if >0.5% 401s sustained 2m or if audit replay misses grant ops.
ops-bot: snapshot created: snap-4377777000. artifact: s3://sec-dryruns/4377777000-snap.tar.gz
harper: owner heuristic: owner tag > onboarding-ticket > last-auth within 200d. ambiguous = manual review. exclude keys with external grantees.
dmitri: paste exact KMS commands so infra can tail.
harper: commands (staging):
```
aws kms revoke-grant --key-id alias/stg-keystone --grant-id gr-01ab
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/stg-keystone --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/stg-keystone --operations Encrypt Decrypt
```

sre-watch: i'll monitor token refresh errors and pod restarts. callback threshold: token err >0.4% or restarts >3 in 5m.
audit-bot: capturing playback window for CloudTrail + audit-proxy.
harper: running canary now. post diffs and audit-proxy traces please react with :eyes:.
dmitri: :eyes: watching keystone-api traces
sre-watch: watching infra metrics
ops-bot: KMS op started: kms-op-437777-A. export checksum sha256:4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288
harper: canary complete. results: keystone-api had a single 401 spike (0.32%) during revoke window; recovered after grant reapply + 1 restart. billing-ingest unaffected. audit-proxy and CloudTrail show RevokeGrant/CreateGrant for alias/stg-keystone.
dmitri: any cross-account grants flagged?
harper: none in the canary; three keys in inventory flagged for manual review due to external grantees.
sre-watch: infra notes: token refresh spike lasted ~40s, no pod flapping.
harper: next: run three staggered staging passes, then propose prod in 15m windows. will open RFC-SEC-9001 and attach logs + rollback playbook. thanks all.
